articleTitle: Why Reminding Your Teen About Grades Doesn't Work
imageHeadline: Why Nagging Your Teen About Grades Backfires
imageSubtext: See what actually builds motivation instead
pinTitle: why nagging teens about grades doesn't work and what helps motivation instead
pinDescription: If you have a bright teen with no motivation to study, constant reminders about grades often make things worse. Research on adolescent academic motivation shows why nagging backfires and what parents can do instead to support intrinsic motivation. Get the evidence-based strategies that actually help.
